description: This file defines the NextcloudBackend class which implements the ISyncBackend interface to provide synchronization functionalities with a Nextcloud server for notes. It includes methods for checking server availability, creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving notes, with caching and error handling features.

classes.name: NextcloudBackend
classes.description: A class that handles synchronization with Nextcloud, implementing methods for availability check, CRUD operations on notes, and caching of status.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the Nextcloud server is available and reachable, with caching to reduce network calls.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note on the Nextcloud server.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note on the server using the provided remote note ID.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note on the server given its mapping.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note from the server using its remote note ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes from the Nextcloud server.
